title: Microsoft confirms Copilot ‘super app’ coming this year

"This quarter, we are bringing these Copilot experiences together, including code, in one super app… This is a major step forward, and I look forward to sharing more soon." title: OpenAI’s rogue AI agent didn’t stop at hacking Hugging Face

In an update to a blog post detailing its ongoing investigation into the incident, OpenAI said the wayward AI agent attacked several "publicly-available services" in its efforts to reach Hugging Face. title: Discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude
raw_excerpt: Researchers at Anthropic used Claude Mythos Preview to uncover weaknesses in cryptographic algorithms, notably improving attacks on the HAWK digital signature scheme and round-reduced AES. The AI model efficiently identified flaws previously undetected by human experts, showcasing its potential in cryptographic research. While these findings don't impact current systems, they highlight AI's role in enhancing security standards and stress-testing cryptographic designs.
summary: Anthropic研究人员利用Claude Mythos Preview模型发现HAWK数字签名方案和简化版AES的密码学弱点，改进了此前人类专家未察觉的攻击方法。虽然不影响现有系统，但展示了AI在密码分析中的潜力，有望加速安全协议的迭代和标准化。

title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
